pixel_convention: x right, y down, full-resolution pixels; positions outside 0..1919 are extrapolated (object partly out of frame)

camera.motion: static (phase-correlation shift between consecutive frames < 0.01 px over all 39 pairs; frames 0 and 39 differ from the median background only by the plane)
camera.perspective_note: 2D-style shot: plane flies level, parallel to the image plane, in side view; its apparent size stays constant (459 x 95 px) throughout, so a single metres-per-pixel scale applies to the plane. Island/beach/sea are scenery far behind or below the plane path and are NOT at the plane's depth.

objects.name: airplane
objects.description: white twin-engine regional jet (rear-mounted engines, T-tail, thin red/grey cheatline), side view, nose pointing left, landing gear down
objects.visible_frames: 1-39 (entering from right edge frames 1-7, fully in view 8-31, leaving at left edge 32-38, only tail-fin tip at frame 39)
objects.reference_point: centre of the full image bounding box (nose to tail-fin tip, tail-fin top to wheel bottom); at frame 18 = (1070.0, 138.0). Mask centroid is (1070.1, 142.3).

size_px.note: measured at frame 18 (bbox x 841-1299, y 91-185); constant in all fully visible frames (diff-mask extents 449-468 px long, noise from clouds)

objects.motion_summary_px: level straight flight right-to-left; cx = 2177.55 - 61.52*frame (px), cy = 138.0 +- 0.3 px; per-frame |dx| 61.0-62.5 px in fully visible frames (no detectable acceleration: quadratic term 0.0015 px/frame^2)

objects.name: plane_shadow
objects.description: faint dark shadow of the plane on the sea surface, right of the island
objects.visible_frames: 16-29 reliably (enters right edge at frame 16, reaches the island shadow/beach around frame 28-29); faint fragments to frame 33
objects.note: coarse: centroid of darker-than-background blob, +-5 px; moves left ~56-58 px/frame at y ~970

objects.name: rock_island
objects.description: tall grey rock stack covered with green conifers, centre of frame
objects.note: measured at frame 0; right edge excludes the rock's shadow on the sand (which extends to x ~1300)

objects.name: sand_beach
objects.description: white sand beach around the rock base, bottom centre

objects.name: sea
objects.description: turquoise sea from horizon (y ~895) to bottom of frame

objects.name: sky_clouds
objects.description: blue sky with white cumulus clouds; static (no cloud motion detected)

events.event: airplane nose enters frame at right edge
airplane passes image centre x=960 (bbox centre)
airplane last visible (tail-fin tip at left edge)
